baseline: Adopted expert-chain batching enabled; one wait per expert; private isolated executable.
feature: Explicit finish parameter; one wait per eight experts with partial last group. In-order reuse of the same two dequant buffers and padding workspace; original XMX/SwiGLU kernels,FP32 accumulation.
scope: Private isolated build,unchanged FP16/FP32 accumulation,R1 XMX and SwiGLU. 8 banks/78.6MB,128MiB workspace,all128 pool,16 warmups,median7 batches x16 full expert calls. Two-buffer reuse correctness with distinct mixed-shape outputs. No new engine allocations.
rule_before_measurement: A=adopted expert chain,one wait/expert. B=identical kernels,one wait/eight experts,including partial last group. Screen then one independent confirmation,A/B/A/B/A each. Each candidate round:>=6 of15 shapes with absolute adjacent-baseline drift<=3%,median throughput gain>=3%,no eligible regression<-3%. 407 full-output/guard/workspace/mixed-shape/two-buffer-reuse checks per process. Only both passing cohorts proceed to same-EXE IQ2_XS Code256 A/B/A/B/A:both rounds prefill gain>=3%,drift<=3%,4191 slots/5760MiB,exact32 output IDs. No resampling. Separate host attribution adds no waits/barriers; its timings are not speed evidence.

public_integration.scope: Public check recompiled with current public headers,linked frozen measured engine objects, then fresh CMake/CTest registration. Not a full CMake target or dirty-worktree build.
